## 2. Connect a server

On first launch, MCPJam shows a **Welcome** overlay that guides you
through connecting your first server. You can:\n\n* **Enter your own server** — paste an HTTPS URL (e.g. `https://your-server.exam
ple/mcp`) or a STDIO command (Terminal, Desktop, and Docker only).\n* **Try the Excalidraw demo** — a hosted diagramming MCP app,
no setup required.\n\nAfter connecting, MCPJam shows the server name and tool count, then offers an **Open Playground** button tha

t seeds the chat with the prompt:

```
What can this server do?
```

Press **Send** to explore your server's tools. No API k

ey, ngrok, or ChatGPT/Claude subscription needed.

> [!TIP]
>

# CLI Overview

> Local MCP testing and mcpjam cloud: probing, d
ebugging, OAuth, conformance, and hosted evals from your terminal\n\nThe `mcpjam` CLI is two invocations. Local MCP testing stays
at the top level: inspect, debug, and test MCP servers from the command line or CI (connectivity, OAuth, MCP Apps, tools/resources
/prompts, protocol conformance). Most local commands are one-shot; `mcpjam mcp` and `subscriptions listen` keep a process open. Ac
count-bound commands live under `mcpjam cloud` and talk to your MCPJam account. There are no compatibility aliases for the old Clo

ud paths — see [Migrating to CLI 4.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/migration.md).

## Recommended: Use with Agent Skills

The e
asiest way to use the CLI is through the [MCPJam skill](https://github.com/MCPJam/inspector/tree/main/skills/mcp-inspector), which

m/inspector --skill mcp-inspector
```

To convert existing promptfoo, pytest, Jest, or CSV tests, use the [MCP eval import skil

kills add mcpjam/inspector --skill mcpjam-eval-import
```

To drive MCPJam's hosted eval tools — launch a run, poll it to a ver
dict, and triage a failure down to the step — use the [run MCPJam evals skill](https://github.com/MCPJam/inspector/tree/main/skill
s/run-mcpjam-evals). This one is about running suites that already exist, not writing them.\n\n```bash theme={\"theme\":\"css-vari

ables"}
npx skills add mcpjam/inspector --skill run-mcpjam-evals
```

Once installed, your agent will know how and when to in

voke `mcpjam` commands automatically.

## Install

```bash theme={"theme":"css-variables"}
# Global (gives you the mcpjam

command)
npm i -g @mcpjam/cli

# Or run without installing
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest --help
```

> [!NOTE]
>
> All examp

les in these docs use `mcpjam` directly. If you installed via `npx`,
> replace `mcpjam` with `npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest`.

## C

ommand groups

### Local MCP testing

These stay at the program root. They reject `--api-key` / `--api-url` / `--project` — ex

cept `test`, which accepts them only to reach MCPJam-hosted inference.

| Group | Purpose | Key commands |
| - | - | - |
| [`t
est`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals) | Run an eval suite file locally (BYOK or MCPJam-hosted inference); never uploads |
`test <file>` |\n| [`server`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/server-inspection) | Triage connectivity and capabilities | `probe`, `d
octor`, `info`, `validate`, `ping`, `capabilities`, `export` |\n| [`tools`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tools-resources-prompts) |
Exercise the tool surface | `list`, `call` |\n| [`resources`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tools-resources-prompts) | Read resourc
es and templates | `list`, `read`, `templates` |\n| [`prompts`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tools-resources-prompts) | Fetch promp
ts | `list`, `get` |\n| [`subscriptions`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference) | Open a long-lived MCP subscription and stream n
otifications | `listen` |\n| [`tasks`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tasks) | Drive MCP Tasks and validate the tasks wire | `list`,
`get`, `cancel`, `conformance` |\n| [`events`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/events) | List, poll, watch and subscribe to MCP Events
(triggers), and check their conformance | `list`, `poll`, `watch`, `subscribe`, `unsubscribe`, `conformance` |\n| [`apps`](https:
//docs.mcpjam.com/cli/apps-conformance) | Validate MCP Apps metadata and resource wiring | `conformance`, `conformance-suite` |\n|
[`oauth`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/oauth-conformance) | Test OAuth flows and conformance against an MCP server | `conformance`
, `conformance-suite`, `login`, `metadata`, `proxy` |\n| [`protocol`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference) | MCP protocol confor
mance checks | `conformance`, `conformance-suite` |\n| [`readiness`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#readiness-hosted-comman
ds) | Grade a server against a publisher's directory. Hosted `start` / `status` / `list` / `cancel` / `report` stay here (leaf `--
api-key`; no Cloud project link) | `check`, `start claude`, `start openai`, `start muse`, `status`, `list`, `cancel`, `report` |\n
| [`xaa`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/xaa) | Run the Cross-App Access (ID-JAG) debugger against an MCP server | `run` |\n| [`compa
t`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#compat-command) | Check whether a server's tools and widgets work on each AI host | `com
pat` |\n| [`inspector`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#inspector-commands) | Start, open, or stop the local Inspector from
the CLI | `open`, `start`, `stop` |\n| [`mcp`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/mcp-server) | Run MCPJam as a stdio MCP server for agen
ts (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, ...) | `mcp` |\n| [`telemetry`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/telemetry) | Inspect and conf

igure anonymous CLI telemetry | `status`, `disable`, `enable` |

### MCPJam Cloud

Account-bound commands. Declare `--api-key`
/ `--api-url` on `mcpjam cloud` (before or after descendants). `mcpjam oauth login` is MCP-server OAuth; `mcpjam cloud login` is

your MCPJam account.

| Group | Purpose | Key commands |
| - | - | - |
| [`cloud`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud
-workspace) | Account, project link, and workspace | `login`, `logout`, `whoami`, `link`, `status`, `organizations`, `projects`, `

sessions` |
